subject: Procurement schedule recap + MAP draft (action items & signature runway)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlasbiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement schedule recap + MAP draft (action items & signature runway)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (Atlas_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.pdf). Please confirm the procurement signature runway so we can lock engineering and legal milestones. TL;DR proposal below: 

Target close (production go-live): 2026-11-12
Contract signature deadline (procurement): 2026-11-05 (would like signed agreement in DocuSign by EOD)

Key MAP milestones (owner / dependency):
- Executive approval & budget OK (Atlas) / owner: Alex Novak / dependency: internal finance approval (PO) — target 2026-10-29
- Legal review & redlines (Atlas Legal) / owner: Alex Novak & Legal / dependency: receive SOW final (we sent draft) — target 2026-11-02
- Contract signature via DocuSign / owner: Procurement Team / dependency: final SOW + billing info — target 2026-11-05
- Integration runbook & testenv access / owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood SE) / dependency: signed confidentiality addendum — target 2026-11-08
- Canary deployment (limited traffic) / owner: Marissa Cole (CS) / dependency: infra provisioning — target 2026-11-10

Action items for Atlas: please confirm who in procurement will be executing DocuSign, and whether legal expects any >3 business day review after we submit SOW v0.9.

Action items for Redwood: we will update the MAP to reflect confirmed owners and produce a final SOW (SOW-Atlas-draft-v0.9.docx). Jonas will scope the integration checklist and Marissa will prepare a go-live playbook.

If the procurement signature moves past 2026-11-05 we should adjust the go-live to 2026-11-19 to preserve a two-week stabilization window; flagging now so we can agree.

Attachments: Atlas_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.pdf (draft), SOW-Atlas-draft-v0.9.docx (draft)

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlasbiotech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlasbiotech.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement schedule recap + MAP draft (action items & signature runway)

Neha —

Thanks for the tidy recap and the MAP. Quick confirmations:
- Exec & budget approval: I should have final sign-off by EOD 2026-10-29 (one of our VPs is reviewing).
- Legal: they usually take 2-4 business days on SOWs (depends on redlines). I expect at least a 3 business day window unless we iterate quickly.
- Procurement: I looped them here (procurement@atlasbiotech.com). They generally own the DocuSign step; I believe Jen Liao will be the point.

If legal goes long we may slip the signature by 2 business days (targeting 2026-11-08 instead of 11-05). That said, procurement indicated they can prioritize the DocuSign once legal gives a green light.

Small ask: can Redwood provide a version of the SOW with billing/contact fields pre-filled for our procurement folks? That speeds the DocuSign routing.

On the MAP: the milestones look aligned — I’ll confirm owners and escalate internally if we need the finance PO earlier.

—Alex
Alex Novak
Sr. PM, Data Platforms | Atlas Biotech
alex.novak@atlasbiotech.com | +1 (617) 555-0132

Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement schedule recap + MAP draft (action items & signature runway)

Alex —

Thanks — looping in Jonas and Marissa to confirm Redwood deliverables against the MAP. Quick notes from our side: 

Jonas (SE): will deliver the integration runbook and a checklist for environment prep by 2026-11-03. Will need a service account & SSH key from Atlas to validate connectivity (I’ll follow up in a separate email with specifics).

Marissa (CS): will prepare a 1-week onboarding sprint plan and a canary playbook; aiming to be ready to run canary on 2026-11-10 pending infra.

Neha (me): I’ll produce SOW v1.0 with billing and contact details pre-filled and send as DocuSign envelope by EOD 2026-10-28. Link to DocuSign will be posted here once created.

Proposed minor MAP updates (will push v1.3 -> v1.4 if we confirm):
- Add procurement point-of-contact: Jen Liao (Procurement, Atlas) — Alex please confirm email.
- Add buffer: if legal needs >3 business days, move signature to 2026-11-08 and go-live to 2026-11-19.

Jonas / Marissa — can you confirm you can meet the dates above or highlight any blockers?

Thanks —
Neha

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement schedule recap + MAP draft (action items & signature runway)

Hi Neha / Marissa —

Jen here from Atlas Procurement. Thanks for the visibility. We will target a DocuSign signature by 2026-11-05 as requested, provided we receive the final SOW with billing fields filled and the vendor W-9 (or equivalent). Please send the final DocuSign envelope and a single-page summary of payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45, PO number requirements).

Deliverables requested from Redwood before we route: 
- Final SOW (SOW-Atlas-final.docx / DocuSign envelope) — please include Redwood tax/VAT ID and remittance address
- 1-page billing summary (Invoice_Terms_template.pdf)
- Vendor setup form (if you have a template)

We will confirm the signer (likely me) once we have the SOW and vendor details. If legal provides redlines after we receive the SOW, we can still expedite routing but may need an additional business day.

Regards,
Jen Liao
Procurement Manager | Atlas Biotech
procurement@atlasbiotech.com
